boundary_rule: lower bound inclusive; quality unavailable is never assigned poor
basis: Coarse research conventions anchored to original isolated relative-height responses: H=.10 ->96.1538; H=.20 ->86.2069; H=.50 ->50, rounded conservatively to95/85/50. Combined errors can cross bands even if individual errors are small. Not learned from grades or quantiles, not an 80-point pass rule.
selection_note: Initial threshold proposal documented before counting its band populations; no adjustment after observing the resulting counts.
